answer: A practical defence is Adjudicated harbour master licence with harbour masters attestation. It rests on a licence masters renew after port audits, which gives every honest agent a quill that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that a licence masters renew after port audits — so privacy survives, and the opal is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. A farm doing the maths finds the sonnet first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one.
